title: Make a Specific Repair Attempt After a Workable Conflict
description: After a misunderstanding or conflict where it is safe to re-engage, make a specific repair attempt: name what you did, acknowledge the likely impact without arguing about intent, apologize for your part, offer a concrete corrective action, and invite the other person's view. Do not demand forgiveness or immediate reconciliation.

trusted_protocol.title: Make a Specific Repair Attempt After a Workable Conflict
trusted_protocol.description: After a misunderstanding or conflict where it is safe to re-engage, make a specific repair attempt: name what you did, acknowledge the likely impact without arguing about intent, apologize for your part, offer a concrete corrective action, and invite the other person's view. Do not demand forgiveness or immediate reconciliation.
trusted_protocol.action: Wait until you can speak without escalating. Name the specific action or words you are taking responsibility for. Acknowledge the impact as you understand it without using your intention to cancel the other person's experience. Apologize for your part without an 'if'. Offer one concrete repair or behavior change you can actually make, then ask how the other person sees it. Listen to the answer. Do not require forgiveness, agreement, or immediate trust in return.
trusted_protocol.check_in: Did I own a specific part without defending it, offer a realistic repair, and give the other person room to respond or decline?
